[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Plus One** [LC 66 · Plus One](https://leetcode.com/problems/plus-one/){difficulty="Easy"}

It is grade-school addition with a carry. Start at the **least** significant digit (the right end): add the carry, write the remainder, pass on the tens. Only when every digit was a $9$ do you gain a new leading `1`.

[Solved in full in @sec-arr-p4-a.]{.card-link}
